body.text: The peyote cactus has a thick stem. It stores a lot of water. It has no leaves or branches. It doesn't lose much water. The olive tree has shallow roots. They get water fast when it rains. It has small and narrow leaves. They don't lose much water. The tamarisk shrub has deep roots. They take in underground water. It has thin branches. It survives with little water.
